note: BCL-xL (iso1) has BH4+BH3+BH1+BH2 domains; BCL-xS (iso2) lacks BH4+BH1 — BCL-xL has broader heterodimerization capacity with BAX/BAK
sFLT1 (iso2) is soluble decoy lacking TK domain; analogous to sVEGFR2
TrkB-T1 (iso2) lacks intracellular kinase domain
TrkC-T1 (iso2) lacks C-terminal kinase domain (residues 613-839 missing; 227aa truncation)
sAXL (iso2) is soluble extracellular ectodomain only

MDM2-A (iso2 296aa) retains C-terminal RING domain (sequence confirmed identical at C-terminus); difference is p53 substrate selectivity via N-terminal domain loss — both isoforms have GO:0004842 E3 ubiquitin ligase activity
-KTS (iso3) has stronger dsDNA binding; +KTS (iso4) shifts to RNA binding
p42 (iso1) has both TA domains; p30 (iso2) lacks TA1 domain
TIA1 iso2 lacks RRM3; reduced RNA binding affinity
PTBP1 iso2 (PTB4) lacks RRM2; altered RNA binding specificity
ErbB4 iso8 lacks kinase domain
FGFR2 iso14 is soluble secreted form lacking kinase
KIT iso2 has internal deletion in kinase domain activation loop
RUNX2 iso1 (MASNS) has both TA+Runt; iso2 (MRIPV) lacks N-terminal TA region
HIF1A iso2 lacks C-terminal TAD; reduced transcription activation
Survivin-2B (iso3) has extended loop altering BIR-domain protein binding
STAT3alpha (iso1 770aa) has C-terminal transactivation domain; STAT3beta (iso3 722aa) lacks 48aa C-terminal TAD — reduced transcription activation capacity
LAP* (iso1 345aa) has TA1+TA2+bZIP; LIP (iso3 147aa) lacks both transactivation domains — LIP is a dominant-negative that cannot activate transcription
p85alpha (iso1 724aa) has SH3+rhoGAP+iSH2+cSH2 domains; p50alpha/p55alpha (iso2 454aa) lacks N-terminal SH3 and rhoGAP — p85alpha has greater interaction surface
DNMT3A1 (iso1 912aa) has N-terminal PWWP domain for H3K36me2 histone binding; DNMT3A2 (iso2 723aa) lacks first 189aa including PWWP
SMN (iso1 294aa) has full C-terminal Tudor domain for Sm protein binding; SMN-delta7 (iso2 262aa) lacks exon 7 — impaired snRNP assembly
RAC1 (iso1 192aa) has normal GTPase rate; RAC1B (iso2 211aa) has 19aa insert in switch II that reduces intrinsic GTPase activity ~10-fold
